items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: I used to play with Alfred William.

ctx.x: Oh, Alfred Williams, he's thinking of.

Alfred Williams. Oh no. I used to play with Alfred William. He's there. He went away there a long time. Somebody in Texas. But he come back there. He's been there ever since. I used to play with my band too. Let me see who we was playing with when he used to play with us. Sam Morgan, I bet you anything. We had a regular band. He played with Sam Morgan a long time. Sam Morgan. No, he wasn't with us when he was there. He left. He went away. Because we had Alfred Martin with us when I got in the band.
He went to California with Ari. Yeah, Alfred William. Yeah, I know he did. Let's see. Oh, bass player. You didn't tell us about the bass player.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: Alfred Williams used to play with us.

ctx.x: He's had a brother, Kenia, that's the one. He was a violin player in the Kish Sonson. He'd tell you to play with him three or four pieces. Like hustling and that, send a job down the district. He'd play like that. He'd look like happy, huh? So, um... Very happy. Very happy. Very happy. He died now. He died up in Chicago. He could play with me when I was playing with John Robeser. He used to play with all these bands down there. They were very happy. Alfred Williams, you know him, right? Alfred Williams used to…
